products.name: Mwea Pure Pishori (Grade 1)
products.shortDescription: The definitive aromatic Kenyan long-grain rice, renowned for delicate sweetness and captivating natural scent.
products.fullDescription: Harvested directly from the irrigated paddy fields of Mwea, Kirinyaga County, our Grade 1 Pure Pishori is celebrated for its slender profile, tender non-clumping fluffiness upon cooking, and an unmistakable natural aroma that fills the kitchen. Processed through gentle destoning and acoustic optical sorting to preserve kernel integrity.
products.origin: Mwea Irrigation Scheme, Kirinyaga County, Kenya

products.name: Classic Super Long Grain
products.shortDescription: Uniform, polished whole-kernel table rice engineered for dependable yield, firm texture, and everyday dining.
products.fullDescription: A dependable, high-yielding Kenyan milled rice selected for its resilient kernel structure. Each grain cooks cleanly without breaking down or turning mushy, making it the choice of commercial caterers, family kitchens, and restaurants who require consistent volume and visual appeal.

products.name: Fragrant Broken Rice (Catering Grade)
products.shortDescription: Clean, stone-free aromatic broken grains offering rich Mwea flavour at an accessible price point for bulk kitchens.
products.fullDescription: Natural broken kernels produced during the gentle dehusking and grading of pure aromatic rice. Cleaned to the exact same stone-free and dust-free standards as our whole grain rice. Highly economical for volume kitchens, composite rice flour blending, porridges, and hearty rice dishes.

services.name: Cleaning & Destoning
services.tagline: Precision debris and foreign matter removal
services.description: High-throughput rotary scalpers, air aspiration channels, and dual gravity destoners remove dust, chaff, weed seeds, and field pebbles prior to milling.
services.keyCapability: Zero stones guarantee through high-density gravity separation.

services.name: Gentle Dehusking
services.tagline: High kernel recovery with minimal grain stress
services.description: Modern rubber-roll hullers operate with calibrated roller gap clearances to strip the outer paddy husk while preserving the valuable endosperm.
services.keyCapability: Maximizes whole head-rice percentage while minimizing kernel fractures.

services.name: Multi-Deck Grading & Sizing
services.description: Vibratory sieves and indented cylinder separators divide milled rice into strict whole-grain, half-grain, and small broken kernel categories.
services.keyCapability: Accurate classification according to commercial grade standards.

services.name: Optical Sorting & Friction Polishing
services.tagline: High-speed camera detection for immaculate grain
services.description: High-definition optical sorters inspect falling grain streams to eliminate chalky, discoloured, or damaged grains, followed by gentle friction polishing for shine.
services.keyCapability: Removes discolored kernels for an immaculate translucent appearance.

services.name: Custom Weighing & Bagging
services.tagline: Automated bag filling and industrial sealing
services.description: Automated load-cell weighers fill 1kg, 2kg, 5kg, 10kg, 25kg, and 50kg sacks with high-strength stitched closures to prevent spillage and preserve aroma.
services.keyCapability: Available for client-customized sacks or standard Top Grade bags.

aboutText.summary: Rooted in Mwea, Top Grade Rice Millers is focused on delivering carefully processed rice for customers who value quality, consistency and reliability.
aboutText.detail: The Mwea basin is renowned across East Africa for its mineral-rich black cotton soils, fed year-round by the clear mountain streams cascading from Mount Kenya. Top Grade Rice Millers works at the heart of this fertile ecosystem, pairing traditional Mwea grain heritage with modern mechanical milling precision.
aboutText.mission: To provide households, retailers, and commercial institutions with dependably pure, cleanly milled Kenyan rice while upholding operational excellence and transparent business practices.
aboutText.millingCommitment: We operate with strict quality controls: moisture verification upon intake, calibrated sorting, and transparent grading standards.
